prompt_text:
Compute Indian personal income tax under BOTH regimes for income earned from 2024-04-01 through 2025-03-31.
All amounts are annual INR. Cash salary includes HRA but excludes employer NPS; include employer NPS in salary once and claim its allowed deduction separately. No other employer retirement contributions or perquisites exist. Basic+DA includes only DA forming part of retirement salary; no commission. All HRA facts are constant for the whole year; city denotes both place of employment and residential accommodation, and rent is actually paid for accommodation not owned by the employee. 80C, health-insurance and employee-NPS inputs are eligible payments satisfying all statutory conditions; health premiums are non-cash, self/family members are below 60, and no parent or preventive-checkup claims exist. Employee NPS is additional to 80C and not claimed twice. Savings interest is from eligible savings accounts, not fixed deposits. Home interest is for one completed self-occupied property; no pre-construction interest. The home_loan_eligible_2l flag states whether acquisition/construction loan-date, completion and certificate conditions for the higher cap are met; otherwise only the lower cap applies. There is no other income, special-rate income, carried-forward loss, surcharge, penalty, arrears or tax credit.
Recommend the cheaper regime; use new on an exact final-tax tie as the benchmark's explicit tie policy. Cess and statutory rounding apply. Identify the governing Act and sections for the income period, regardless of when a return might be filed.
